combo1.title: Joey Series: Going First Jinzo Lock
combo1.description: Two cards, Alligator's Dragon Knight and Dark Time Wizard, set up a board your opponent can't answer with Traps. The Knight summons itself by revealing Dark Time Wizard and adds Graceful & Skull Dice and Reversal Box. Dark Time Wizard's safe effect adds Swiftwind Panther Warrior and comes back in the End Phase, and Panther turns the Knight into Jinzo - Energy Shocker. End board: Jinzo - Energy Shocker and Swiftwind Panther Warrior, a Set Reversal Box, Graceful & Skull Dice in the Graveyard, and Dark Time Wizard back in your hand. Starting hand: Alligator's Dragon Knight + Dark Time Wizard.

steps.text: Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight in your hand. Reveal Dark Time Wizard, another card in your hand that mentions Dark Time Wizard, and Special Summon the Knight. Your Normal Summon is still unused.
Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight was Special Summoned. It adds two cards with different names that mention Dark Time Wizard.
Add Graceful & Skull Dice from your Deck to your hand.
Add Reversal Box from your Deck to your hand.
The Knight's effect ends with a discard. Discard Graceful & Skull Dice: from the Graveyard it can hit the next monster your opponent summons.
Activate effect: Dark Time Wizard from your hand, choosing its first effect. This is the safe one, with no coin toss.
Dark Time Wizard adds Swiftwind Panther Warrior from your Deck to your hand.
Dark Time Wizard goes to the Graveyard. It returns to your hand during the End Phase.
Normal Summon Swiftwind Panther Warrior.
Activate effect: Swiftwind Panther Warrior (a Quick Effect during the Main Phase).
Tribute Alligator's Dragon Knight from your field as the cost.
Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your Deck.

Your opponent has no Traps yet, so skip Jinzo - Energy Shocker's destroy effect. Its lock is already on: Swiftwind Panther Warrior on your field and Alligator's Dragon Knight in your Graveyard both mention Dark Time Wizard, so your opponent can't activate Trap Cards or effects.
Set Reversal Box. Activate it in your opponent's Draw Phase so it's face-up for their Standby Phase, when it rolls for counters.
End Phase: Dark Time Wizard's first effect adds it from your Graveyard back to your hand.

combo2.title: Joey Series: Going Second, Called Right
combo2.description: Going second into a board with monsters and Set Traps. Sleepy Scapegoats brings Tokens and Swiftwind Panther Warrior, Panther Tributes a Token for Jinzo - Energy Shocker, which destroys your opponent's Traps while its lock stops them chaining new ones. Alligator's Dragon Knight adds Graceful & Skull Dice and Foolish Graverobber. Then Dark Time Wizard's coin toss. This line is the right call: your opponent's monsters are destroyed and they take half their original ATK as damage, and the open Exceed procedure adds a 3400-ATK attacker. Exceed, Jinzo, Panther and the Dragon Knight swing for 9,500 before Graceful & Skull Dice adds at least 400 more to each. Exceed's own summon effect needs a Level 8 or lower monster in your hand or Graveyard, and this line has none, so skip it unless you drew one. Starting hand: Sleepy Scapegoats + Dark Time Wizard + Alligator's Dragon Knight. Your Normal Summon stays unused.

steps.text: Activate Sleepy Scapegoats.
Special Summon a Sacrificial Sheep Token in Defense Position. The card allows up to 4, but two leave Main Monster Zones free for the rest of the line.
Special Summon the second Sacrificial Sheep Token.

Your opponent controls a monster, so Sleepy Scapegoats also Special Summons Swiftwind Panther Warrior from your Deck. For the rest of the turn it limits what you can summon from the Extra Deck, and Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed still qualifies.
Sleepy Scapegoats goes to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Swiftwind Panther Warrior.
Tribute a Sacrificial Sheep Token as the cost. A monster was Tributed this turn, so Panther can attack.
Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your Deck.

Activate effect: Jinzo - Energy Shocker was Special Summoned. Destroy every Trap your opponent controls, revealing the Set ones, and Jinzo gains 300 ATK for each. Panther is on your field, so the lock is already on and your opponent can't activate those Traps in response.
Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight in your hand. Reveal Dark Time Wizard and Special Summon the Knight.
Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight was Special Summoned.
Add Graceful & Skull Dice from your Deck to your hand.
Add Foolish Graverobber from your Deck to your hand.
Discard Foolish Graverobber.
Activate effect: Dark Time Wizard from your hand, choosing its second effect. Toss a coin and call it.

Called right. Destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, and they take half those monsters' combined original ATK as damage. A monster was destroyed by Dark Time Wizard, so Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed's Extra Deck procedure is open for the rest of this turn.
Tribute your other Sacrificial Sheep Token. The Token's restriction only covers Normal Summons, so it can pay for Exceed's procedure.
Special Summon Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed from your Extra Deck.
Activate effect: Foolish Graverobber in your Graveyard. Banish it.
Set Sleepy Scapegoats from your Graveyard, so you have a fresh wall to flip on your opponent's turn if the attack doesn't end the Duel.

Battle Phase: activate Graceful & Skull Dice and roll two dice. Exceed, Jinzo, Panther and the Dragon Knight all mention Dark Time Wizard, so each gains the total x 200 ATK. Even the lowest roll adds 400 to each.
Attack. Exceed (3400), Jinzo (2400, plus 300 for each Trap it destroyed), Panther (2000) and the Dragon Knight (1700, and it can attack directly) come to 9,500 ATK before the dice.

combo3.title: Joey Series: Going Second, Called Wrong
combo3.description: The same opening as the called-right line, but Dark Time Wizard's coin toss goes the other way and destroys every monster you control, Tokens included. A monster was still destroyed by Dark Time Wizard, so Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed comes out anyway, by Tributing one of your opponent's monsters. That gets past effects that stop targeting or destruction. Exceed then revives Jinzo - Energy Shocker, and the Trap lock holds because Exceed and the Panther in your Graveyard both mention Dark Time Wizard. Starting hand: Sleepy Scapegoats + Dark Time Wizard + Alligator's Dragon Knight. Your Normal Summon stays unused.

steps.text: Activate Sleepy Scapegoats.
Special Summon a Sacrificial Sheep Token in Defense Position.
Special Summon the second Sacrificial Sheep Token.

Your opponent controls a monster, so Sleepy Scapegoats also Special Summons Swiftwind Panther Warrior from your Deck. For the rest of the turn it limits what you can summon from the Extra Deck, and Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed still qualifies.
Sleepy Scapegoats goes to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Swiftwind Panther Warrior.
Tribute a Sacrificial Sheep Token as the cost.
Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your Deck.
Activate effect: Jinzo - Energy Shocker was Special Summoned. Destroy every Trap your opponent controls, revealing the Set ones. Its lock is already on, so they can't respond with those Traps.
Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight in your hand. Reveal Dark Time Wizard and Special Summon the Knight.
Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight was Special Summoned.
Add Graceful & Skull Dice from your Deck to your hand.
Add Foolish Graverobber from your Deck to your hand.
Discard Foolish Graverobber.
Activate effect: Dark Time Wizard from your hand, choosing its second effect. Toss a coin and call it.
Called wrong. Destroy all monsters you control, starting with your last Token. Don't count on Sleepy Scapegoats here, because its Token is destroyed in the same wipe.
Jinzo - Energy Shocker is destroyed.
Swiftwind Panther Warrior is destroyed.
Alligator's Dragon Knight is destroyed.
Dark Time Wizard goes to the Graveyard. Monsters were still destroyed by Dark Time Wizard, so Exceed's procedure is open.

Your field is empty, so Tribute 1 face-up monster your opponent controls to Special Summon Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed from your Extra Deck. Tributing doesn't target or destroy, so it gets past effects that only stop those.
Activate effect: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed was Special Summoned.

Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker (Level 7) from your Graveyard. Its Trap-destroying effect is once per turn and already used, but the lock holds: Exceed on your field and Panther in your Graveyard both mention Dark Time Wizard.
Activate effect: Foolish Graverobber in your Graveyard. Banish it.
Set Sleepy Scapegoats from your Graveyard for your opponent's turn.
Battle Phase: activate Graceful & Skull Dice. Exceed and Jinzo gain the total x 200 ATK, and every monster your opponent still controls loses the same, before you attack.

Attack with Exceed (3400) and Jinzo (2400). Exceed is unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell and monster effects, and they still can't activate Traps. Your Normal Summon is unused for Main Phase 2.

combo4.title: Joey Series: Opponent's Turn With Reversal Box
combo4.description: What the going-first board does on your opponent's turn. Reversal Box flips in their Draw Phase and rolls for counters in their Standby Phase. Graceful & Skull Dice answers their first summon from the Graveyard and destroys it on a total of 6 or more (26 of 36 rolls). When they activate a monster effect on the field, Reversal Box tosses a coin: called right, it summons Fisherman of Legend from your Deck and sets the target to 0 ATK with its effects negated, and Fisherman destroys another monster. Called wrong, only the counter is spent, and you can try again on their next monster effect or attack while counters remain.

steps.text: Your opponent's Draw Phase: flip the Set Reversal Box face-up. It's a Continuous Trap, so it stays on the field.
Their Standby Phase: Reversal Box rolls a six-sided die. Place counters on it up to the result, with no more than 6 on the card.

Your opponent Normal Summons a monster. Activate effect: Graceful & Skull Dice in your Graveyard. Banish it, target that monster and roll two dice. A total of 6 or more destroys it, which happens on 26 of the 36 possible rolls.
Your opponent activates a monster effect on the field. Activate effect: Reversal Box. Remove 1 counter, target that monster and toss a coin.

Called right. Special Summon Fisherman of Legend from your Deck; until the end of the turn the target has 0 ATK and its effects are negated. If it's still face-up on the field, that also negates the effect it just activated.
Activate effect: Fisherman of Legend was Special Summoned. Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls. Fisherman returns to your hand during the End Phase.

End Phase: Fisherman of Legend returns to your hand. While Reversal Box is on the field, it can Special Summon itself from your hand the next time your opponent activates a monster effect on the field or attacks.

combo5.title: Classic: Time Wizard's Thousand-Year Gamble
combo5.description: The classic line from before Beyond the Brave, and the reason Time Wizard is on this page. Toss Time Wizard's coin while it's your only monster, so a wrong call costs you just 250 LP (half its 500 ATK) and Time Wizard itself. A right call clears your opponent's monsters, then Polymerization ages Baby Dragon a thousand years into Thousand Dragon, which attacks an empty field. If the call is wrong, Time Wizard is gone and there's no Fusion this turn. Starting hand: Time Wizard + Baby Dragon + Polymerization.

steps.text: Normal Summon Time Wizard.

Activate effect: Time Wizard. Toss a coin and call it. Called right: destroy all monsters your opponent controls. Called wrong, it would destroy Time Wizard, your only monster, and you would take 250 damage.
Activate Polymerization.
Send Time Wizard from your field to the Graveyard as material.
Send Baby Dragon from your hand to the Graveyard as material.
Fusion Summon Thousand Dragon, a Baby Dragon a thousand years older.
Polymerization goes to the Graveyard. Attack directly with Thousand Dragon (2400 ATK).
